name: Heirloom

perks.name: Ultralight Rail
perks.description:
Lightweight rail construction makes it easier to handle.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Decreases reload speed

perks.name: Light Heatsink
perks.description: Lightweight, agile battery. Increases handling and vent speed.

perks.name: Bullwhacker
perks.description: Aim down sights for a period of time to overcharge the next bolt fired. Increases damage and area of effect for each charge level.

perks.name: Short-Action Stock
perks.description:
This weapon is especially easy to grip.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed

flavor: The antiquated design of this weapon suggests inheritance from a parent who fought in the old emperor's wars; its condition suggests it was discarded recently.

catalyst.name: Heirloom Catalyst
catalyst.description:
Direct hits with charged shots scorch the target. This weapon deals more damage against scorched targets.
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.
